title.en: Autumn Colors on the Qiao and Hua Mountains

medium.zh: 引首：紙；紙；拖尾：紙；隔水二：綾；隔水三：綾

dimensions.en: Image 28.4 × 93.2 cm; Mounting strip 1 12.3 cm; Frontispiece 28.2 × 99.6 cm; Mounting strip 2 10.9 cm; Mounting strip 3 11.1 cm; Colophons 28.4 × 320.2 cm

intro.zh: 1295年，赵孟頫在北方做官多年后回到南方。他的朋友周密祖籍济南，却从未去过那里，赵孟頫便为他画下了济南的两座名山：尖尖的华不注山和圆圆的鹊山。这种有意朴拙、仿古的画法，上追唐代以前的绘画，也为元代文人画指出了方向。
intro.en: In 1295 Zhao Mengfu came home to the south after years as an official in the north. His friend Zhou Mi's family came from Jinan in Shandong, a place Zhou Mi had never seen, so Zhao painted its two famous hills for him: the sharp peak of Mount Hua and the low, rounded Mount Qiao. Its deliberately simple, old-fashioned style looked back to painting before the Song and pointed the way for the scholar-painters of the Yuan dynasty.

look_for.zh: 两座山：右边是尖顶、青绿色的华不注山，左边是低矮圆浑的鹊山。
look_for.en: The two mountains: the pointed blue-green peak of Mount Hua on the right, and the low, rounded Mount Qiao on the left.

look_for.zh: 树上点点红黄，是秋天的颜色。
look_for.en: Touches of red and yellow in the trees: the autumn colours of the title.

look_for.zh: 两山之间的水边有渔舟和茅屋。
look_for.en: Fishing boats and cottages along the marshy shore between the hills.

look_for.zh: 手卷从右往左展开。整卷上，画的前后还有乾隆皇帝的题字和历代题跋，这里只显示画作本身。
look_for.en: Handscrolls open from right to left. On the full scroll the painting is surrounded by the Qianlong emperor's inscription and later colophons; only the painting is shown here.

alt.zh: 一幅横长的设色手卷：平坦的水泽边有树木和茅屋，右边是一座尖尖的青绿山峰，左边是一座低矮的圆山。
alt.en: A wide handscroll in soft colour: flat marshland with trees and cottages, a pointed blue-green peak on the right and a low, rounded hill on the left.

image_choice.note: The painting only; the museum image is the whole scroll, with later inscriptions.
